notes: Rates/brackets are from the official 2026 NJ-1040-ES rate schedules (Table A single/MFS; Table B MFJ, head of household, qualifying widow(er)); they are not indexed and are unchanged from 2020-2025. Head of household uses Table B.
New Jersey gross income is built from NJ net profits from business (federal Schedule C with NJ adjustments, Schedule NJ-BUS-1), not federal AGI; there is no standard deduction.
Personal exemption is $1,000 each for the taxpayer and spouse/CU partner; extra exemptions for age 65+, blind/disabled, veterans and dependents are not modeled.
Medical expenses over 2% of NJ gross income are deductible (Worksheet F) - only the self-employed health insurance part is captured via conformity; the rest is not modeled.

Property tax deduction or credit, NJ EITC, child tax credit, pension/retirement exclusion, Alternative Business Calculation Adjustment, and credit for taxes paid to other jurisdictions are not modeled.
Losses in one category of income cannot offset income in another category (other than via the Alternative Business Calculation Adjustment); not modeled.

seDeduction.note: NJ taxes net profits from business (Schedule NJ-BUS-1); the federal deduction for half of SE tax is a federal AGI adjustment with no NJ counterpart.

seHealthInsurance.note: The self-employed health insurance deduction is allowed in full as part of the NJ medical expense deduction (NJ-1040 line 31, Worksheet F line 5, not subject to the 2% floor).

retirementContributions.note: New Jersey does not allow a deduction for SEP-IRA contributions, but self-employed 401(k) contributions are deductible (NJ-1040 instructions). The calculator applies this based on the plan type you choose.

qbi.note: New Jersey does not start from federal taxable income and has no QBI deduction.

localIncomeTax.note: New Jersey municipalities do not levy a resident income tax (Newark's payroll tax is an employer tax, not an individual income tax).

estimatedTax.threshold: NJ income tax expected to be more than $400 after withholding and other credits
estimatedTax.safeHarbor: Interest is charged on underpayments unless payments equal at least the lesser of 80% of the current-year tax (66 2/3% for farmers) or 100% of last year's tax (prior year must be a full 12-month return with a tax obligation); other exceptions on Form NJ-2210.
estimatedTax.form: NJ-1040-ES (interest computed on Form NJ-2210; see GIT-8)

businessCosts.llcFormationFee: $100 Certificate of Formation (NJ Division of Revenue and Enterprise Services fee schedule).
businessCosts.annualReportFee: $75 annual report, due each year by the end of the anniversary month of formation.
businessCosts.franchiseOrMinimumTax: None for a single-member LLC taxed as a sole proprietorship (NJ Corporation Business Tax minimums apply to corporations).
